QX_TOKEN.description: Quotex ssid token (extract from browser DevTools). Required for live data — sim mode is permanently disabled.

_notes_FIX_DEEP_AUDIT_2026_07_26_F_19_40: Increased healthcheckTimeout 30→60s. Cold start imports brain.py + time_patterns.py + algorithm_monitor.py (each opens SQLite tables); 30s was too tight on Railway cold start and caused spurious deploy failures. A-10 PROBLEM 34.
_notes_CALIBRATION_2026_07_29: Added QX_DISABLE_LIVE_REEVAL=1 to disable LIVE re-eval (was the #1 accuracy killer — 88% of signals got demoted to confidence=15 with 43% win rate).
_notes_PERSISTENT_VOLUME_REQUIRED: CRITICAL: Railway does NOT persist the filesystem by default. Every redeploy wipes signals.db, losing ALL signal history, brain_learning, and brain_predictions. BOTH steps below are required — mounting the volume alone does NOT persist data, because db.py / core/brain.py / core/*.py all defaulted DB_PATH to a path OUTSIDE the volume (app root) unless an env var told them otherwise: (1) Railway dashboard -> your service -> Settings -> Volumes -> Add Volume, Mount Path '/app/data'. (2) DB_PATH is now set to '/app/data/signals.db' in this file's env block (was missing before 2026-07-31 -- this is the step that was silently making step (1) alone insufficient). (3) Redeploy and check the boot logs: db.py now logs a persistence marker boot_count on every startup -- boot_count > 1 confirms the volume is real; boot_count always resetting to 1 after every redeploy means the volume isn't actually mounted at this path. Without real persistence, the brain adaptation system never accumulates enough samples (needs 20+ per pair) and learned_weights stays at 0.
_notes_TELEGRAM_ALERTS_OPTIONAL: Optional: set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in Railway Variables (not committed here) to get a Telegram message the moment the Quotex token dies or the feed goes stale, and again when it recovers -- see alerts.py and .env.example. QX_TOKEN expires ~24h and previously died with zero notification.
